name: chicken-charming

purpose.why: Rebuilt on Evan's request (2026-10-22) to replace the Ranch tile's original model with a crafted one, keeping its game role.
purpose.audience: children building and playing in a miniature ranch

brief.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a plump farm hen, warm white feathers with golden tips, a red comb and wattle, a yellow beak and legs, standing in side view, chibi proportions, a big round head, short stubby legs, rosy cheeks, plush toy-like, cheerful

concept.tool: Midjourney web app (midjourney.com/imagine), driven in Evan's signed-in Chrome by Claude through the Claude in Chrome extension, one job at a time, text prompts only (no image reference)

hero.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a plump farm hen, warm white feathers with golden tips, a red comb and wattle, a yellow beak and legs, standing in side view, chibi proportions, a big round head, short stubby legs, rosy cheeks, plush toy-like, cheerful, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 1:1
hero.pick_reason: chibi hen in side view with golden-tipped feathers, red comb and wattle, comb not near the edge

turnaround.prompt: orthographic turnaround sheet, front view, side view, back view, evenly spaced, same scale, a whimsical storybook version of a plump farm hen, warm white feathers with golden tips, a red comb and wattle, a yellow beak and legs, standing in side view, chibi proportions, a big round head, short stubby legs, rosy cheeks, plush toy-like, cheerful, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 16:9
turnaround.pick_reason: front, side and back of one chibi hen with margin around each view

construction.by: modeler agent, directed by the art director (Claude)

rounds.change: First charming build from the normal hen's structure: ball body, big head, lobed comb, petals, wing pads, lobed tail, stubby legs with pants. 2,834 triangles (over budget).
Cut to 1,418 triangles (fewer segments, one breast puff instead of scallops), wings inset and rolled to hug the flanks, body moved forward.
Shorter back, bigger lower breast, head and beak forward, wing tips flat to the pad, feeding tilt 50 deg; hero camera calibrated to 68/8.
Rump squashed (x0.86) and the tail more upright; underside of the rump lifted, deeper breast sag.
Legs and hips moved 2.6 cm forward under the breast, breast puff forward, bigger golden collar tips.
Smoother body (14x8) and head (12x8), cream wing pads so the wing reads, thicker wing.
Collar flared out like the hero's ruff (front dropped to 0.758), then pulled back halfway.
Slimmer body and wings, taller comb (hero 0.769); comb height reverted.
Tail lobes longer and swept further back (36-82 deg), wing tips raised so they stop poking below the rump.
Wings brought in to keep the footprint near the normal hen's W/L (0.79 -> 0.74).
Final 768 px / 48 sample render and score; to_game.py chicken-charming.

what_was_done: Copied models/chicken (build.py, make_views.py, hero_check.py, poses_check.py, run.sh) and reshaped it. Same part tree and pivots (body at the hips > neck > head > comb/wattle/beak/face/eyes/pupils, body > tail_under > tail, body > wing_l/wing_r > plates, body > breast_plates, neck > hackles/hackle_tips, leg_l/leg_r as separate roots), same POSE mechanics (part rotations, body drop, peck slide, leg fold) and the same three states idle/feeding/rest. Z up, origin at the footprint centre on the ground, head faces -Y.

make_views.py was rewritten for this sheet: the backdrop is each row's left and right edge colour blended across the row (follows the hero's wall-to-floor gradient and darker upper-left vignette); above the belly line a 0.045 colour-distance key, closed and hole-filled; below it only leg colour (gold-orange, G/R under 0.80; the warm cast shadow is 0.86) under the body's width, cut below the lowest toe row. This keys out the hero's long cast shadow and the sheet's floor shadows.

The sheet's side view is drawn three-quarter, facing right, and shows a fluffy tail-less egg where the hero has a raised golden tail, so it contradicts the hero. It lives in views/side/ and is scored apart as a proportion guide only. Front and back are scored by the harness.
hero_check.py recalibrated on the round-3 model over a 6x4 yaw/elevation grid (best 70/6 and 60/0); set to yaw 68, elevation 8.

A plush round ball body (0.20 m wide, breast sagging forward and low, rump squashed and its underside curving up into the tail, flattened belly) plus one soft breast puff; an oversized round head (12.8 x 12 x 11.6 cm, almost twice the normal hen's) on a short plush neck; short stubby legs moved 2.6 cm forward under the breast, each in a fluffy cream feather pant, with three fat toes and a little back toe.

A big comb of three fat round lobes (middle one tallest), a small stout rounded beak, a fat two-lobed red wattle, dark oval eyes with a white shine, pink blush cheeks, a collar of 8 chunky rounded hackle petals with big golden tips, a big cream wing pad on each flank with three golden tip lobes trailing back, and a perky fan of 3 cream and 2 golden fat tail lobes.
Every pose keeps the storybook tilt: the body leans 6 deg into its step and the head is cocked 9 deg to the side and turned 4 deg (TILT in build.py).

idle is the hero stance. feeding tips the body 50 deg and the neck 34 deg, raises the tail and slides the head 4 cm along the neck until the beak tip touches the ground. rest sinks the body 4 cm onto the ground and folds the legs (with their pants) back up inside it.

1,452 triangles in every pose (budget 1.5k), 22 meshes, smooth shaded, one flat material each. Material names keep the normal hen's (Feather_White, Feather_Cream, Feather_Gold, Skin_Red, Horn_Yellow, Skin_Yellow, Skin_EyeDark); Skin_EyeOrange is gone (the toy eyes are solid dark) and Skin_Cheek and Skin_EyeShine are new for the blush and eye shine. All map to the game's skin role, as before. Footprint 0.24 x 0.32 m (W/L 0.74, normal 0.69), 0.41 m tall. to_game.py chicken-charming scaled it x3.368 to the old footprint and wrote chicken-idle/feeding/rest .json and .glb into the -charming tree without errors.
construction.creative_additions: A permanent storybook head cock and forward lean, fluffy feather pants on the legs, a white shine in each eye, pink blush cheeks, and a cream under-layer behind the golden tail lobes.

geometry.up: Z (Blender source); Y in GLB and game
geometry.origin: centre of the footprint, on the ground

good: Hero silhouette 0.784 from the hero direction: the round ball body, big round head, big three-lobed comb, wattle, cocked head, cream wing pad and raised golden tail all read.
Front 0.840 and back 0.861 against the sheet (mean 0.851), above the normal hen's 0.737, because the charming massing is simpler and rounder.
The three poses are distinct at tile size: upright and cocked, head down at the ground with the tail up, a round sitting lump.
off: The hero's surface is soft clay-smooth; at 1.5k triangles the body and head show broad facets even with smooth shading.

The hero's hackle collar is a clear ruff of gold-tipped petals over the breast; flaring the petals out far enough to match it widened the front silhouette too much (front 0.82 -> 0.76), so they sit closer and read mostly as golden flecks at the shoulders.

The wings were brought in (half width 0.12 m) so the footprint stays near the normal hen's proportions (W/L 0.74 against 0.69); a wider wing pad matched the hero a little better (0.795 against 0.781).
The side view of the sheet was dropped (three-quarter and tail-less); it scores 0.559 as a guide only.
A taller comb matched the sheet's front better but cost 0.02 on the hero, so the comb follows the hero.
The feeding pose stretches the neck by sliding the head 4 cm along it, as in the normal hen.
